prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 跨行类别 · 产品线 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "智能手机" spans 1 col × 3 row; "可穿戴设备" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "类别" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 2: header "产品" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 92px
  col 3: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 4: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 307px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示不同产品类别下的产品、价格和主要特点，便于浏览与比较。","reading":"读者先按左侧合并的类别定位产品，再横向读取价格和说明，也可沿价格列比较各产品；合并类别内的多行高度可容纳类别名称换行。","groups":["类别与产品共同标识商品，类别通过跨行合并组织产品。","价格与说明分别提供可比较的数值和产品特点，按行共同描述对应产品。"],"keep_intact":["价格金额及货币符号","产品型号和数字等不可分割的标识","各列标题"],"may_wrap":["说明文字可在自然位置换行","类别名称可在合并单元格内换行","产品名称可在名称与型号之间自然换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [84, 118, 71, 206] · table 480×265px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [90, 118, 71, 200] · table 480×265px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"产品名、型号和价格都保持完整；说明列较宽，长说明均控制在两行，横向阅读清楚。","problems":"“可穿戴设备”在合并单元格内断成两行，末尾单独留下一个字，类别标签显得局促。","cause":"类别列宽 84px，扣除边距和边框后不足以容纳完整名称。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"类别名称完整显示，两个跨行类别更容易扫读；产品、价格和标题也都保持完整，行高与 r2A 相同。","problems":"说明列略显紧张，第一条说明和可穿戴设备的说明换行位置较靠前，后者将“监测”拆到两行。","cause":"类别列增至 90px 后，说明列缩至 200px；产品列的 118px 相对其内容仍有少量可调整空间。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r3A","widths":[90,113,71,205],"change":"保留 r2B 完整的类别标签，将产品列缩至恰好容纳其最长单行内容的宽度，把腾出的 5px 给说明列，观察长说明的换行是否改善。"},{"name":"r3B","widths":[88,113,71,207],"change":"进一步收紧类别列，为说明列争取宽度；重点检验“可穿戴设备”能否仍保持一行，以及说明的断行是否更自然。"},{"name":"r3C","widths":[90,116,71,202],"change":"保留类别列宽，同时只从产品列借出 2px，作为更稳妥的微调方案，检验产品名称与说明的实际换行。"}]}
